overal.goal: Low priority. Let n8n run boof's process: an n8n workflow can drive the pipeline (planner, developer, observer, reviewer and any extra steps) through boof's API, react to boof events (webhooks) and create work. Boof must run fully with or without n8n; the built-in pipeline stays the default. Users can review and manage the n8n workflows from boof. After each edit a user makes to a workflow, boof adds a simple task that runs it and checks the final result. Start by checking where n8n fits (pipeline steps need a 'run one step' operation in the API; webhooks and task creation already exist).
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
Every new capability is reachable through REST, MCP and the CLI as well as the web UI and the desktop app.
Write a short design document first, including how boof detects that n8n is absent and falls back.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.
Do not make n8n a required dependency or start it from boof by default.

versions.version: Requested by the owner on 2026-10-29; not started.
D7 (owner, 2026-10-29): approved — n8n runs external pipeline steps called by webhook with a callback, rather than a 'run one internal step' API; built last.

tests.strategy: Unit tests for the step operation and the edit-to-check-task rule; an end-to-end run with a local n8n and with n8n absent.
